content.comment_body: With the cable connected, open the program and go to tools > options > interface. Try automatically detecting the interface. Then connect to the device and proceed with your work. Hope this helps, happy new year

Hello, The [product_name] [article_no] version can be set to transfer mode via the software, so you don't need to stop the device manually. The programming software will prompt you if the device should be stopped. If you're unable to connect, there may be an issue with either the cable or the configuration settings. Check that drivers are installed and the correct port is selected if you're using a USB cable; for RS232 cables, ensure the right COM port and settings are chosen. You can review your programming software settings under Tools > Options > Interface. There's also an Autodetect button available as mentioned previously. For RS232 cables, verify the port settings in the Windows system as well. Regards, [user_name]
